From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@pinebridge.com>

Subject: CAIQ priority sampling request for onboarding window

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we prepare for our internal evidence review next week, the compliance team asked for a short prioritized sampling of CAIQ responses and exemplar artifacts to speed our validation.

Top asks (we'd like these by EOD Friday 7/16 if possible):
- Exemplar implementation evidence for controls related to encryption + key management (e.g., CC-Data-Protection/CC-Encryption-at-Rest, CC-Key-Management subcontrols).
- A small sampling (2–3) of runtime telemetry log snippets that show tenant-scoped request traces for inference calls (redacted to remove PII).
- A short mapping table that ties your CAIQ responses to the control IDs we'll be validating (examples: control id, Redwood assertion, artifact name).

Attached is a simple priority list from our side (pinebridge_caiq_priorities.pdf) and a worksheet with our expected columns. If you need more time we can push the validation start by 48 hours, but it would help our audit if we can get a minimal bundle earlier.

Can you confirm who on your side will own each artifact and whether you can provide DocuSign access for the acceptance checklist?

Best,
Lara Chen
VP, Security & Compliance
Pinebridge Health

Attachments: pinebridge_caiq_priorities.pdf

- CAIQ control mapping table: Naomi Feldman (me) will produce a compact CSV mapping control IDs -> our assertion -> artifact filename.

Action items for my team (Kimberly / Marissa): please assemble artifacts into a Drive folder, create an "exemplar_manifest.xlsx" listing artifacts and owners, and add the mapping CSV. I'll share a DocuSign link for the acceptance checklist once the bundle is ready.
